comment: She is terrible, stay away from her class with a 10 foot pole if you can
Worst class I've ever taken. She will not help you if you're struggling and she treats intro level classes like a 300 level. I will never recommend her to people

Dr. Ferman is hilarious because she is so eclectic. By far one of my favorite professors at UR because of her easy-going attitude. If you don't do well in class, it's not because of her. Go to class, take notes, and regurgitate that information on the exam and essay in order to do well. Not a hard professor!

This professor made me feel terrible about my abilities. She interrupts us during class, she corrects what we say, and she is very unclear about her assignments and expectations. When her students voice a confusion or miscommunication, she blames it on us. Please do not take her if you can help it.

Please please please do not take her. She is extremely unclear and no one has a clue what is expected from class to class. There is no structure and yet she expects you to execute precisely what she is looking for. Throughout the semester I had no clue where I stood in terms of grades and still have no idea what to expect. DON'T TAKE HER.
She is the worst teacher I've had thus far.

Do not take a class with Claudia!She is disorganized, unclear &a basket case.She would not assign homework very clearly,so when everyone came to class and told her that she did not give us any, she yells and says we are conspiring against her to not do our homework. Her textbook was homemade out of random worksheets and plays, without page numbers.
She's crazy, but still a cool teacher.

She is very unorganized and unclear in assigning topics. Most of the time she doesnt know what she wants from the students in an assignment until AFTER it has been assigned. Most of the classes I have had with her I come out wondering what i actually learned. Grades inconsistently and with bias.
She is very cool, kinda hard, but very interesting and in touch with students
